fields.System.Title: INB-207 — Flag damaged goods into quarantine
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to flag visibly damaged goods as I receive them, so that
they never enter sellable stock.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a receipt line, then part of the quantity can be marked damaged with a reason.
  • - Given damaged quantity on confirmation, then it is created in quarantine status, not
  • available.
  • - Given damaged quantity, then it lands in a quarantine location, separate from the good
  • stock on the same line.
  • - Given the damage, then a discrepancy record is created against the supplier.
  • - Given damaged stock, then it is never allocated.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | receipt_line, stock_balance |
| Risks | Damaged goods received as good ([doc 05 WF 1](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
